import sys
from collections import deque

def bfs(start, parent, visited, g):
    q = deque([(start, 0)])
    visited[start] = True
    while q:
        u, dist = q.popleft()
        for v in g[u]:
            if not visited[v]:
                visited[v] = True
                parent[v] = u
                q.append((v, dist + 1))
            elif parent[u] != v and dist % 2 == 0:
                return dist + 1, u, v
    return -1, -1, -1

def find_odd_cycle(n, g):
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if not visited[i]:
            cycle_length, u, v = bfs(i, [-1] * (n + 1), visited, g)
            if cycle_length != -1:
                return cycle_length, u, v
    return -1, -1, -1
